newsitem.title: IRAN: Force four quake hits area northeast of Tehran.
newsitem.headline: Force four quake hits area northeast of Tehran.

text.p: An earthquake measuring four on the Richter scale jolted an area 50 km (30 miles) northeast of the Iranian capital Tehran on Tuesday, the official news agency IRNA said.
It said the 9.06 a.m. (0536 GMT) quake "caused no loss of life or damage to property."
A force four earthquake is powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
Nearly 1,000 people died when an earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale hit northwest Iran in late February.
